**Failure-Mode Diagnosis:** The franchisor is treating **franchise-authority divergence** (global brand/IP equity-control logic vs. local franchisee-sovereignty over labor, real-estate, local sourcing, government-license interface, and association collective-action), **currency-inflation divergence** (fixed USD-royalty linearity vs. Lira/EGP/Naira/Real/Rupiah depreciation, parallel-exchange markets, FX-scarcity, and sovereign-interest-rate divergence), **collective-bargaining divergence** (European/North-American unit-contract individualism vs. Turkish *UFRAD*, Egyptian franchisee-association collective organization, Nigerian labor-association adversarialism, Indonesian cooperative-mediation culture, and Brazilian *ABF*-institutionalized legal-advocacy), **hidden upstream USD-design dependency** (royalty contracts hard-coded in USD; supply-chain pricing, equipment-import financing, marketing-fund obligations, and IT/cloud costs denominated in USD behind localized menu translation; local partners treated as license-fee collectors rather than governance-counterparties with veto over contract-modulation, supply-decoupling, and association-correlation), and **stable-currency cross-subsidy blindness** (company-owned stores in hard-currency markets retaining full profit while crisis clusters suffer hidden USD-drain) as a **localized-contract-translation + partner-banner adaptation**: translating franchise-agreement pages into local language while retaining USD-royalty clauses; allowing local associations to interpret restructuring requests as temporary promotional discounts rather than structural governance changes; delaying core **franchise-authority ontology / currency-modulation ontology / collective-bargaining recognition / hidden-USD-dependency mapping / local-financing-correlation / supply-chain-decoupling verification / crisis-firewall design** until a **2026 crisis** (franchisee-association collective boycott in Egypt/Nigeria triggering sovereign regulatory intervention and partner-license withdrawal; currency-depreciation rendering USD-royalty collection physically impossible and forcing emergency contract breach; hidden USD supply-chain pricing exposure causing viral cross-market association solidarity strikes; government price-control boards revoking operating licenses for “foreign-currency extraction”; competitive displacement by certified local champions with audited local-currency franchise economics, sovereign-bank supply-credit, and association-integrated governance) forces emergency global-recentralization—producing **restructuring-certification divergence** (translated “local-currency-certified” agreements with hidden USD supply-pricing and clawback provisions), **unverified collective-integrity promises** (“association-partnered restructuring” with no audited council veto or hidden-dependency disclosure), **regulatory/enforcement action** (FX-control breach allegations; price-gouging investigations; partner-license revocation; data-sovereignty breach in loyalty/cloud systems), **partner and association abandonment** (local master-franchise partners withdrawing real-estate/license covenants; franchisee councils blocking supply access; religious/compliance boards in Indonesia revoking Halal-operational correlation), or **permanent market lockout to locally engineered franchise champions** with audited local-currency economics, sovereign-bank supply-credit, and institutionalized collective-governance architecture.

The correct model is a **modulated global franchise-integrity footprint**: a standardized global **franchise-economic-integrity backbone** (non-negotiable ethical-operational taxonomy for Tier **S—Systemic-Strategic** / franchise-authority ontology, currency-modulation ontology, collective-bargaining ontology, hidden-USD-node taxonomy, supply-decoupling ontology, local-financing-correlation ontology, anti-culture-washing registry, crisis-firewall, qualification-registry, franchisee-association pipeline, royalty-modulation backbone, supply-chain backbone, group-capital backbone) with defined jurisdiction-residency, cluster-certification baseline, and regulatory/partner/association/government requirements; a **separated commitment-component registry** tracking every regional restructuring agreement as **Migration Investment** (contract-restructuring build + currency-modulation system + local-currency facility build + supply-decoupling verification + association-council build + hidden-USD-remediation + local-bank covenant) + **Local Credibility Reservation** (franchisee-relief reserve / currency-shock reserve / association-conflict reserve / regulatory-intervention reserve / market-lockout reserve / sovereign-FX-breach reserve / cross-contamination reserve) + **Group Capital Capacity Commitment** (Base unified global brand/core-supply/core-IT preservation + Swing/Protection for cluster transition/crisis funded by stable-market company-store liquidity and global-core profit retention) + **Transition Window Quarter**; a **dual-corridor verification rule**—a “qualified cluster entry” means full franchisee-association / government-regulatory / banking-sovereignty / supply-chain-auditor / organizational-intermediary audit and hidden-USD-dependency mapping completed—not a translated contract memo with localized menu imagery; a **fragmentation firewall** preventing unqualified (**B0/B1**) framework claims, “paper dual-currency-compliance” status (e.g., “EGP-certified restructuring” with hidden USD supply-pricing and clawback), or hidden USD-architecture dependency; **franchise-interaction geo-traceability mandate**—every royalty-payment event, collective-bargaining event, currency-state event, supply-pricing event, association-vote event mapped to jurisdiction cluster and franchise-source cluster with upstream USD-dependency and legal-dependency flagged; and a **global crisis-escalation protocol** for association-collective-action, currency-depreciation breach, hidden-USD-exposure, partner-license rupture, regulatory-suspension, organizational-lockout, supply-access denial, or audit failure.

### 2. Cluster Profile Definitions: Currency, Collective & Hidden-USD Modes

**Profile P-TR — Turkey: High-Inflation / Lira-Depreciation / UFRAD-Collective / Import-Heavy / Government-Mediated / Master-Franchise Dominant Cluster**
*Representative Divergence: Severe Lira depreciation against USD; high CPI making fixed-USD royalties confiscatory; *UFRAD* association culture demanding restructuring; government-mediated licensing; heavy import dependence for core proteins and packaging.*
- **Currency-Inflation Covenant**: Lira depreciating with high inflation; parallel-rate risk moderate but official-rate divergence growing. Fixed USD royalty creates effective extraction rate rising monthly.
- **Collective-Bargaining Covenant**: *UFRAD* and regional franchisee groups active; negotiation culture direct and government-mediated; collective boycott capacity present but institutionalized through association rather than wildcat.
- **Hidden-USD Dependency Exposure**: Royalties fixed USD; imported beef/poultry supplements priced USD; packaging and branded materials USD-denominated; marketing-fund contribution fixed USD; master-franchise fee amortization in USD; local partner treated as license-fee collector without veto over restructuring terms or supply-decoupling.
- **Franchise-Authority Divergence**: Global brand equity controls menu/IP; local master-franchise partner holds government-license, real-estate access, and association-legitimacy but lacks audited veto over contract-modulation or hidden-dependency disclosure.
- **Restructuring Pathway**: **GBIC** (minimal hard-currency brand fee, ~1.5–2%, settled in TRY at CBRT reference rate, audited quarterly) + **LMOC** (variable local-currency fee, ~3–5%, indexed to Turkish food-CPI, paid monthly in TRY). Deferred-royalty capitalization permitted for 2025–2026 transition window (unpaid LMOC capitalized as subordinate local-currency debt, clawback only upon CPI-recovery). Local-bank facility (Ziraat/İşbank partnership) for local-currency working capital, not USD credit. Supply-decoupling: core sauce/proprietary items preserved global; local poultry, vegetables, packaging sourced and audited locally.

**Profile P-EG — Egypt: Severe-Devaluation / Parallel-Market / Association-Organizing / FX-Scarcity / Price-Control / Sovereign-Regulatory Cluster**
*Representative Divergence: EGP parallel-market spread; FX scarcity making USD settlement physically impossible for many franchisees; franchisee associations organizing nationally; government food-price controls; import-license dependence on local partner.*
- **Currency-Inflation Covenant**: Severe official/unofficial rate divergence; FX scarcity; inflation extreme. Fixed USD royalty forces franchisees to source USD on parallel market, destroying margins.
- **Collective-Bargaining Covenant**: Franchisee associations organizing collectively across governorates; negotiation culture adversarial with government mediation possible; collective action includes supply-blockade and license-protest.
- **Hidden-USD Dependency Exposure**: Royalties USD; all imported ingredients (cheese, sauces, packaging) priced USD; equipment imports financed USD; marketing fund USD; hidden clawback provisions in master agreement allowing global to seize local bank accounts for USD arrears.
- **Franchise-Authority Divergence**: Local partner holds import-license and government-interface authority; association demands restructuring veto; global treats partner as fee-collector.
- **Restructuring Pathway**: **GBIC suspended/reduced to symbolic TRY-equivalent in EGP at official CBE rate** (only on audited net-revenue, not gross), with explicit suspension during 2026 crisis window if parallel-rate divergence exceeds 30%. **LMOC fully EGP**, indexed to CAPMAS food-basket inflation, collected via local-bank direct debit (not USD wire). Deferred capitalization: all unpaid GBIC/LMOC during transition converted to local-currency equity in franchise entity, with global retaining dilution-protected minority. Supply-decoupling: mandatory local sourcing audit for poultry, produce, and packaging; core proprietary items priced in EGP-equivalent basket, not USD invoice. Local-bank covenant with CIB/National Bank of Egypt for EGP revolving credit.

**Profile P-NG — Nigeria: Naira-Multi-Window / FX-Scarcity / Adversarial-Association / Import-Dependency / Union-Solidarity Cluster**
*Representative Divergence: Naira official/NAFEM/I&E window divergence; FX scarcity; strong franchisee and labor union solidarity; import dependency; partner-bank conflict risk.*
- **Currency-Inflation Covenant**: Multi-exchange-window complexity; depreciation rapid; inflation high but variable regionally. USD royalty settlement requires accessing scarce FX.
- **Collective-Bargaining Covenant**: Adversarial association and union culture; collective boycott and solidarity strikes across clusters highly probable; government labor mediation weak but present.
- **Hidden-USD Dependency Exposure
